_note: Shape reference. Copy to config/host.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in ids from YOUR host catalog. `active` picks the entry G0 reads. This repo commits no model ids on purpose.

<session-switch-host>._note: A host that can only switch model per session (most IDE/CLI tools).

models.code: <cheap model whose price does not jump on long context>
models.review: <different model, ideally another family, never weaker than code>

invocation.review: <command to start a FRESH review session>

<role-binding-host>._note: A host that can bind a model per profile/agent/subagent (Codex, Claude Code, opencode).

rules: At G0 write the resolved ids into .pipeline.json.models — the state file, not this template, is what a later session reads.
If review resolves to the same model as code, set review_degraded: true and say so; never claim a cross-model review you did not run.
If the host cannot bind a model per stage, the design->code->review handoffs stay manual session switches; that is a host limitation, not a pipeline failure.
